status: design freeze before any extension-v2 outcome-bearing run

known_results.external_confirmation: DiverseVul labels may be counted for frozen eligibility but are not joined to model outputs until prediction sealing

external_fold.labeled_source: all exact-deduplicated PrimeVul rows except every row in the same frozen alias group as the DiverseVul target project
external_fold.unlabeled_target_context: the complete exact-deduplicated selected DiverseVul target project
external_fold.evaluation_target: the same DiverseVul target project, with labels kept in a separate vault until prediction sealing
external_fold.source_partition: commit-hash buckets under split_salt vultriage-extension-source-v2: train 0-69, model validation 70-79, calibration 80-99
external_fold.same_name_exclusion: apply the union of the v1 and extension-v2 alias maps; exact and aliased project-group matches are excluded from PrimeVul source

deduplication.canonicalization: normalize CRLF to LF, strip trailing horizontal whitespace per line, trim outer whitespace
deduplication.within_dataset: retain the first deterministic row; quarantine conflicting labels
deduplication.cross_dataset: exclude every DiverseVul row whose exact key occurs in PrimeVul from external confirmation

near_duplicate_audit.tokenizer: C/C++ lexical alphanumeric and operator tokens
near_duplicate_audit.action: report sensitivity excluding flagged cross-dataset pairs; do not replace the primary exact-deduplicated analysis

frozen_codebert.revision: resolved commit must be recorded before embedding extraction
frozen_codebert.pooling: attention-mask mean of final hidden states excluding special tokens
frozen_codebert.precision: float16 encoder inference; float32 stored embeddings
frozen_codebert.head: class-weighted L2 logistic regression
frozen_codebert.head_standardization: StandardScaler fit on source train only; transform source validation, calibration, and target unchanged
frozen_codebert.head_solver: scikit-learn LogisticRegression solver=liblinear, penalty=l2, dual=false, fit_intercept=true, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-6
frozen_codebert.selection: source validation PR-AUC; ties choose smaller C

primary_operating_point.reason: fixed in v1 and highlighted before extension-v2

prom_reference.label: PROM-derived (binary, deterministic bug-fixed adapter)
prom_reference.binary_fix: explicit two-column one-hot encoding for APS and RAPS
prom_reference.local_space: sealed two-class probability simplex with Euclidean distance
prom_reference.neighbors: all calibration points when n_calibration<200, otherwise floor(0.1*n_calibration), stable index tie-break
prom_reference.local_p_value: per test point mean(calibration_score_at_neighbors >= test_score), no finite-sample plus-one correction
prom_reference.credibility: strict p > 1-alpha, preserving the PROM-specific rule
prom_reference.acceptance: an expert accepts only a singleton prediction set with credibility true; union/OR rejection means automation requires all experts to accept
prom_reference.randomness: explicit expert seed equal to detector seed; no automatic alpha selection and no target-label expert selection
prom_reference.raps: 20% deterministic calibration tuning split; lambda grid 0.001,0.01,0.1,0.2,0.5; ties choose smaller lambda
prom_reference.report: report four experts, their union, and LAC-only; never call this official PROM or official reproduction

support_gate.development_policy: fit only on the 12 PrimeVul project-disjoint pseudo-targets and their already-visible v1 raw clip-20 results; no DiverseVul model output or outcome is available
support_gate.confirmation_policy: apply the frozen gate unchanged to exact-deduplicated DiverseVul projects
features: maximum and p99 test-point infinity mass per label
fraction of weights clipped at each boundary

learner.aggregation_unit: one row per PrimeVul project and risk-budget cell after averaging the five detector seeds
learner.feature_transform: log1p total and class ESS; for each target point take the maximum test-point infinity mass over the two calibration labels, then use the project maximum and p99; domain AUROC; lower and upper calibration-weight clipping fractions; StandardScaler fit inside each training fold
learner.model: L2 logistic regression, solver=liblinear, C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, fit_intercept=true, max_iter=2000, tol=1e-6, random_state=20260814
learner.group_crossfit: LeaveOneGroupOut by target project; each held-out project's nine budget rows are scored by a model that never saw that project
learner.severe_violation: max(vulnerable_violation/alpha_vulnerable, safe_violation/alpha_safe) > 0.5 for estimated_weight_no_support_clip_20 after seed averaging
learner.threshold: 0.5 on the cross-fitted severe-violation probability; the final scaler and model are refit on all PrimeVul development rows without tuning
learner.gate_pass: predicted severe-violation probability < 0.5 and the raw prediction set contains at least one singleton; probability exactly 0.5 fails
learner.detector_transfer: the one frozen gate is used unchanged for both hashing-SGD and frozen-CodeBERT outputs; detector identity is not a feature

support_gate.removed_v1_feature: positive_neighbours because clipped weights are strictly positive and the count is not local support
support_gate.failure_rule: if pass does not predict lower raw violation on DiverseVul, remove predictive-gate claims and retain the gate only as a model-based conservative refusal heuristic; do not describe it as a valid risk predictor

diversevul_target_selection.selection: after the frozen alias map and exact deduplication, rank eligible project groups by vulnerable count then total count then normalized group name; use all eligible groups up to 24, never inspect model outcomes
diversevul_target_selection.freeze_requirement: write project list and source hashes before any DiverseVul label-bearing evaluation

report: feature or embedding extraction wall time
peak allocated and reserved GPU memory
efficiency.hardware: record exact CPU, GPU, driver, framework, batch size, and sample count

statistics.seed_handling: average seeds within project before inference
statistics.paired_test: two-sided exact Wilcoxon only with at least 10 nonzero project differences
statistics.multiplicity: Holm within each outcome by detector and budget family
gate_discrimination: median pass-fail difference with project bootstrap interval
statistics.unfavorable_results: retained without project, seed, budget, or method removal

stopping.lightweight: all eligible projects, both detectors, and five seeds complete or fail once with a recorded error
stopping.no_adaptive_addition: do not add projects, seeds, thresholds, or budgets in response to observed results

protocol_amendment.reason: close the source-fold, gate-learner, PROM-adapter, and CodeBERT-head degrees of freedom before any extension-v2 model output exists
protocol_amendment.outcomes_visible_at_amendment: PrimeVul v1 only; DiverseVul model outputs and label-probability joins do not exist
